title: Quasi-coherence of each Koszul normal determinant term
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a Koszul-regular closed immersion into a Noetherian scheme, with r a locally constant natural-valued function equal to the conormal stalk finrank. For every n∈ℕ, the explicit locallyRankedExteriorTerm of the dual conormal in degree n is quasi-coherent. The scheme, immersion, regular sequence, ideal sheaf, pullback, internal Hom, rank-stratified term and stalk are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pur-sheaf-hom], [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex], [def-pc-module-stalk-functor].

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-koszul-dual-conormal-rank-stratum to obtain finite local freeness of rank n for the dual conormal restricted to the rank-n open.
Apply lem-sc-exterior-sheaf-top-invertible. The resulting invertible module is quasi-coherent by the proved source-library instance Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible.isQuasicoherent.

The locally constant fiber is closed; its open inclusion is a closed immersion by IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion and Scheme.Opens.range_ι. Apply the proved source-library closed-immersion quasi-coherent pushforward theorem (isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isClosedImmersion, recorded in lem-pc-closed-immersion-coherent-cohomology). Unfold the prescribed term and simplify the nonnegative integer cast and toNat to obtain the conclusion.

theorem koszulRegularImmersion_dualizing_term {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z, r z = Module.finrank (Z.presheaf.stalk z)
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorTerm
      (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := Z.sheaf)
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
        (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) r (n : ℤ)).IsQuasicoherent
